import sys

def find_second_hole(start, p):
    visited = set()
    current = start - 1
    while True:
        if current in visited:
            return current + 1
        visited.add(current)
        current = p[current] - 1

n = int(input().strip())
p = list(map(int, input().strip().split()))
result = [find_second_hole(i + 1, p) for i in range(n)]
print(" ".join(map(str, result)))
